import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import bootstrap

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv')

# Identify the column for 'Not Documented' responses
not_documented_column = 'Q10_ML_Documentation_Not_Documented'

# Extract the relevant column
not_documented_values = df[not_documented_column]

# Calculate the proportion of respondents who selected 'Not Documented'
proportion_not_documented = np.mean(not_documented_values)

# Perform bootstrapping to calculate the 95% confidence interval
bootstrap_result = bootstrap((not_documented_values,), np.mean, confidence_level=0.95, random_state=42)

# Extract the confidence interval
confidence_interval = bootstrap_result.confidence_interval

proportion_not_documented, confidence_interval

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import bootstrap

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv')

# Convert the 'Q10_ML_Documentation_Not_Documented' column to numeric
df['Q10_ML_Documentation_Not_Documented'] = df['Q10_ML_Documentation_Not_Documented'].apply(lambda x: 1 if x == 'not quoted' else 0)

# Extract the relevant column
not_documented_values = df['Q10_ML_Documentation_Not_Documented']

# Calculate the proportion of respondents who selected 'Not Documented'
proportion_not_documented = np.mean(not_documented_values)

# Perform bootstrapping to calculate the 95% confidence interval
bootstrap_result = bootstrap((not_documented_values,), np.mean, confidence_level=0.95, random_state=42)

# Extract the confidence interval
confidence_interval = bootstrap_result.confidence_interval

proportion_not_documented, confidence_interval
